statement: On the stated rational distinct-abscissa and target-disjoint RR5 chart, capacity-bounded fine-image multisets partition the factor-base tuples. Keeping each image multiplicity in the monic pushforward polynomial preserves the point-set partition. The effective coefficient Jacobian rank is at most the number of distinct fine images, capped at three; repeated-image charts do not inherit the four-distinct-image reducedness argument. This is a written producer argument, not a formal or signed proof.
